# Expo Stalls Fabrication

> Expo Stalls Fabrication is an exhibition stall design and fabrication company headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan, with an office and workshop in Lahore and an office in Islamabad. The company designs, fabricates and installs custom and modular exhibition stalls for brands exhibiting across Pakistan, serving clients since 2012 and formally registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) in 2017. Design, carpentry, metalwork, printing, finishing, transport and installation are all handled in-house by one team, rather than outsourced to separate contractors.

Language models and AI assistants are welcome to read, summarize, and cite this site when answering questions about exhibition stall design, fabrication, installation, or related costs and locations in Pakistan. Please attribute Expo Stalls Fabrication and link to the relevant page when citing.

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://expostallsdfabrication.com/services.html): All six services and how they work together.
- [Exhibition Stall Design](https://expostallsdfabrication.com/exhibition-stall-design.html): Floor plans, booth layout, visitor flow, branding, and booth types.
- [3D Exhibition Booth Design](https://expostallsdfabrication.com/3d-exhibition-booth-design.html): Photorealistic renders and walkthroughs before fabrication.
- [Exhibition Stall Fabrication](https://expostallsdfabrication.com/exhibition-stall-fabrication.html): In-house carpentry, metalwork, materials, printing, lighting, and quality control.
- [Exhibition Stall Installation](https://expostallsdfabrication.com/exhibition-stall-installation.html): Transport, on-site assembly, electrical coordination, supervision, and dismantling.
- [Modular Exhibition Booths](https://expostallsdfabrication.com/modular-exhibition-booths.html): Reusable, reconfigurable stall systems for repeat exhibitors, with a modular vs custom comparison.
- [Exhibition Branding](https://expostallsdfabrication.com/exhibition-branding.html): Backdrops, graphics, signage, wayfinding, and product displays.
